stage.note: No funding announcement, press release, or investor mention was found for Veertu/Anka anywhere (company blog/about page, Hacker News history back to 2016, or any accessible aggregator - Crunchbase, Growjo, Owler and Tracxn all blocked or returned no profile in this environment). The company's own 'journey' page describes organic product evolution (Veertu Desktop in ~2015-2016, open-sourced in Sept 2016, then a pivot to the Anka CI/CD product line) with no mention of raising capital, an accelerator, or investors, which is consistent with a small bootstrapped/self-funded software vendor, but that is not confirmed by any primary source, so stage is left unknown rather than guessed.

note: Veertu Inc. (USA) is a small, apparently privately-held/independent software company selling macOS virtualization products (Anka Build/Build Cloud, Anka Flow, Anka Develop, Anka Crypt/MCP). Its own history page traces back to 'Veertu Desktop' (open-sourced Sept 2016) with no mention of an acquisition, parent company, accelerator, or funding round. Search engines (DuckDuckGo, Google, Bing) in this environment returned either connection timeouts, CAPTCHA blocks, or unrelated spam/ad results for every funding-related query, and Crunchbase/Growjo/Owler/Tracxn/LinkedIn all blocked automated access, so ownership/funding/revenue beyond 'independent US company' could not be confirmed within the time budget. A buyer should independently verify company size and financial stability before relying on Anka for critical CI/CD infrastructure, since no public funding or revenue signal exists to gauge durability.
